disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

evidence.zh: 插件向宿主 webserver 注册了未鉴权的会话删除接口（见 FND-001），本地可达且可先枚举会话再删除，构成无认证破坏性 RPC 面。
evidence.en: The plugin registers an unauthenticated session deletion interface with the host webserver (see FND-001), locally reachable and allowing session enumeration before deletion, constituting an unauthenticated destructive RPC surface.

title.zh: 未鉴权的会话删除接口可被本地进程直接调用
title.en: The unauthenticated session deletion interface can be called directly by local processes

description.zh:
宿主端向宿主 webserver 注册了 POST 会话删除接口（src/index.js 删除接口注册段），处理函数仅解析请求体并校验会话 id 格式（必须为合法 UUID 形态），随后永久删除该会话：停止运行中的代理、删除磁盘日志目录、清除投影缓存与工作区记账。接口无任何鉴权、CSRF 防护或审批令牌；同文件还注册了会话列表接口，可枚举全部会话。

客户端侧的风险确认弹窗只在界面层约束用户操作（勾选「我已了解后果」后才能点删除），并不构成接口级保护——绕过界面直接调用接口即可删除。

dsh 宿主 webserver 本身无 TLS/认证（生态固有），本插件在该无认证面上新增了具破坏性的写操作端点。
description.en:
The host-side registers a POST session deletion interface with the host webserver (src/index.js delete interface registration section). The handler only parses the request body and validates the session ID format (must be a valid UUID shape), then permanently deletes the session: stopping any running agent, deleting disk log directories, and clearing projection caches and workspace accounting. The interface has no authentication, CSRF protection, or approval token. The same file also registers a session list interface that can enumerate all sessions.

On the client side, the risk confirmation dialog only constrains user actions at the UI layer (the delete button is only clickable after checking "I understand the consequences") and does not constitute interface-level protection—bypassing the UI and calling the interface directly can delete sessions.

The dsh host webserver itself has no TLS/authentication (an ecosystem inherent), and this plugin adds a destructive write endpoint on this unauthenticated surface.

evidence.zh: src/index.js:352-379 注册删除接口，处理函数对请求体仅做 JSON 解析与 sessionId 校验后即调用删除核心；src/index.js:234-236 校验仅正则（`if (!SESSION_ID_RE.test(sessionId))`）；src/index.js:333-348 注册列表接口返回全部会话；src/client.js:324-328 客户端直接 POST（`fetch('/__chameleon/session/delete', { method: 'POST', ... body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId: target.sessionId }) })`），无令牌。
evidence.en: src/index.js:352-379 registers the delete interface; the handler only JSON-parses the request body and validates sessionId before calling the deletion core; src/index.js:234-236 validation is only a regex (`if (!SESSION_ID_RE.test(sessionId))`); src/index.js:333-348 registers the list interface returning all sessions; src/client.js:324-328 the client directly POSTs (`fetch('/__chameleon/session/delete', { method: 'POST', ... body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId: target.sessionId }) })`) with no token.

impact.zh:
后果：任何能访问本机 dsh webserver 的本地进程（或能触达回环的网页内容）可先枚举会话再永久删除会话数据，无需用户确认；删除会停止运行中的代理任务。

触发条件：dsh 运行期间，调用方需能访问宿主 webserver（默认本机回环可达，宿主自带无认证设计），并取得合法会话 id（列表接口即可枚举）。

定级依据：未见恶意意图证据，属于快照中真实可达的滥用路径（未鉴权破坏性接口），按 MEDIUM 收录；删除面限于会话数据、不涉及凭据窃取或代码执行，故不升档。
impact.en:
Impact: any local process able to access the local dsh webserver (or web content that can reach loopback) can enumerate sessions and then permanently delete session data without user confirmation; deletion stops running agent tasks.

Trigger condition: during dsh runtime, the caller must be able to access the host webserver (default local loopback reachable, host inherently unauthenticated) and obtain a valid session ID (the list interface can enumerate).

Severity rationale: no evidence of malicious intent; this is a genuinely reachable abuse path in the snapshot (unauthenticated destructive interface), recorded as MEDIUM; the deletion surface is limited to session data and does not involve credential theft or code execution, so no escalation.

The plugin manifest does not explicitly declare capability fields; declared_capabilities are inferred from actual code inspection; the host engine version is not declared, and engines.dsh is inferred from the tool SDK dependency range. The peer dependency @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools is a semver range declaration, a normal registry dependency, not an un-pinned git reference.
